name: Adult Red Dragon

traits.name: Legendary Resistance
traits.desc: If the dragon fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The dragon makes three Rend attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting to cast Scorching Ray.

actions.name: Fire Breath
actions.desc: 60-foot Cone. Dexterity save DC 21: 59 (17d6) Fire damage on a failure, half on a success.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc: Charisma (spell save DC 20). At will: Command, Detect Magic, Scorching Ray. 1/day: Fireball.

actions.name: Commanding Presence
actions.desc: The dragon uses Spellcasting to cast Command. It can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

actions.name: Fiery Rays
actions.desc: The dragon uses Spellcasting to cast Scorching Ray. It can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

actions.name: Pounce
actions.desc: The dragon moves up to half its Speed and makes one Rend attack.

desc: A tyrant of the peaks. It demands tribute from every valley it can see and burns the ones that forget.
treasure: Hoard: coins, gems, art objects and at least one magic item.
